Cost optimization

Five ways to reduce spend.

01Model Selection & Reasoning Effort
The Waste
Teams default to flagship models (e.g., Claude 3.5 Sonnet) for routine extraction, classification, or formatting tasks that smaller models perform identically.
The OneOps Fix
Dynamically evaluates incoming prompt complexity and routes routine tasks to high-speed, cost-effective models (e.g., Claude 3.5 Haiku, Amazon Titan Lite) while adjusting reasoning budgets on demand.
Typical Savings
25% - 45%
02Semantic & Regional Routing
The Waste
Static routing leads to concurrency throttling, regional pricing disparities, and unnecessary multi-region cross-talk.
The OneOps Fix
Routes requests to the most cost-effective Bedrock endpoint and AWS region that meets latency and compliance requirements.
Typical Savings
10% - 20%
03Automated Enterprise Prompt Caching
The Waste
RAG applications repeatedly send the same multi-kilobyte system instructions, vector search context, and examples on every single turn.
The OneOps Fix
Automatically identifies common prompt prefixes and leverages Bedrock prompt caching mechanisms to slash input token costs by up to 90%.
Typical Savings
30% - 70% on cached inputs
04Context & Payload Compression
The Waste
Verbose documents, redundant whitespace, markdown artifacts, and conversational chatter bloat prompt tokens.
The OneOps Fix
Real-time semantic compression algorithms eliminate redundant tokens before dispatch without altering model comprehension.
Typical Savings
15% - 30%
05Autonomous Batch Inference
The Waste
Asynchronous workloads (daily summaries, document processing, backfill tasks) are executed in real-time at peak spot pricing.
The OneOps Fix
Automatically detects asynchronous requests, queues them, and executes via Amazon Bedrock Batch Inference during off-peak windows at a flat 50% discount.
Typical Savings
50% flat discount on async jobs
